title: 1 issue but its fixable and now best coffee maker
text:
1 issue but its fixable and now best coffee maker. UPDATE 8 MONTHS
DO NOT BUY....
LEAKS SO BAD. OUT OF TOP OF UNIT. I TOOK APART AND WAS UNABLE TO FIND LEAK POINT

1 issue!!! The beans jam up around the plastic grinder cover, but beans do not get pushed in to grinder making coffee weak
FIX:
In the bean hopper there is a plastic security cover over the grinder, I removed that and now this IS THE BEST COFFEE MAKER WITH AUTO GRINDER..

Just do not fo this mod if you have small children who could put hand in grinder.

product_metadata.title: 10 Cup Programmable Coffee Maker e With Burr Conical Grinder, Grind & Brew Coffee Machine, 50 Oz Capacity Coffeemaker Carafe Built In Coffee Beans Grinder/ Bold Function/ For Home & Kitchen
features: ☕ Fully Automatic Coffee Machine: Combines the functions of a filter coffee machine and a coffee bean grinder. Freshly ground coffee powder retains its original taste, which is the basis for a delicious cup of coffee.

☕ Selectable Grinding Option ： It is equipped with 8 levels to adjust the thickness of the coffee powder to the needs of different coffee lovers and 2-12 cups mounts of coffee ground. The conical grinder and sharp blades precisely grind the coffee beans to release the mild aroma of the coffee beans.
☕ Adjustable Concentration ： The number of cups and the coffee strength can be selected via buttons, and the high-resolution LCD display can help you select functions.
☕ Programmable Timer: wake up to a hot cup of coffee with fully programmable functionality. you can set the brewing time up to 24 hours in advance, save time and simplify your morning routine.

☕ Simple Operation: 1. Put water in the water tank. Put 2 coffee beans in the coffee bean container. 3. Select the grinding degree. 4 Choose the cup of cofee ground and the concentration. 5. Finally, press the start button.
